items.title: “… not three more people moving in to help with the rent …”
items.where: The inner child, the guards, and the inner adult’s three jobs, P2
items.my_version: Here I’m going to talk about what you develop in yourself as you reparent your inner child. I’m going to talk about it in terms of three jobs: your loving Nurturer, your safe Adult Protector (hereafter just the Protector) and your wise Guide. That’s one grown-up doing three jobs, not three more people moving in to help with the rent, and each job keeps the others in balance. Say a party gets to be too much for your little one. The Protector gets you both out of there, and on the way home the Nurturer tells them they did great, even though mostly they hid in the bathroom. And the Guide helps them think twice about the next weird party they might go to, avoiding another cycle of bathroom vacationing. 🙈 It’s you that needs to develop these qualities.

items.title: The script after “Say something like,”
items.where: Make the hypnosis more alert, P1
items.my_version:
Aside from focusing on things in your direct experience, you can also suggest yourself into greater alertness (it's still relaxed-alert, not paranoid-alert). Keep your eyes open. Use a small hand movement each time you make the auto-suggestion that you're gaining increasing clarity. Then stop the hand movement and see where your mind is at. That hand movement is the mental escape into the body's flow.

items.before:
Aside from focusing on things in your direct experience, you can also suggest yourself into greater alertness (it's still relaxed-alert, not paranoid-alert). Keep your eyes open. Use a small hand movement each time you make the auto-suggestion that you're gaining increasing clarity. Then stop the hand movement and see where your mind is at. That hand movement is the mental escape into the body's flow. Say something like,

“Starting with your eyes open, press your thumb to your forefinger, gently, and let go. As you do, you begin to bring yourself into a place of clearer awareness… Press and let go again, and you’re clearer still. And once more, into the clearest state of awareness yet. Now stop pressing. In the first second after you stop, notice if there’s any echo of the pressing in your fingers, in your breathing, in your attention, or nowhere at all. Just notice, sit up straight and work from this level.”

items.title: Appendix E’s prayer to the subconscious
items.where: Appendix E: Is the daydream helping or replacing your life?, P5
items.my_version: If it is taking you away from life, then change your body position by sitting upright, open your eyes, feel your feet and ask your subconscious to help you.
items.before: If it is taking you away from life, then change your body position by sitting upright, open your eyes, feel your feet and ask your subconscious to help you. Simply say to yourself, “Dear subconscious, thank you for showing me images. If what you are showing me is helpful, then please also show me the guidance in it. If what you are showing me is a way of avoiding dealing with life, then please show me in a gentle but structured way how to deal with life as it is right now.”
